intro: Lesson 29. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

questions.q: Hifdh test: today's group recites Al-Mutaffifin to the teacher. Everyone else completes the qalqalah and itbaq check on the pupil PDF.
questions.a: Rubric marked; written check answers on the teacher sheet.

questions.q: Extend: write your target for next half term.
questions.a: For example: 'Keep a short, clean qalqalah with no extra vowel.'

questions.q: Which letter is both qalqalah and itbaq?
questions.a: A) ط. ط is in قطب جد (qalqalah) and in ص ض ط ظ (itbaq).
covers the roof of the mouth
options: covers the roof of the mouth

questions.q: Think again: Al-Mutaffifin starts with cheating and ends with reward and justice. What is the main lesson for you?
questions.a: Be honest in everything; Allah records it all, and the righteous will be rewarded.
